title: Is the world getting better or worse? A look at the numbers | Steven Pinker
summary: Steven Pinker's TED talk presents data on homicide, war, poverty and pollution to argue that the world has improved over the past decades. He frames progress as problem-solving, not inevitability.
why: Cited as a data-backed counter to doom and pessimism about the state of the world.

quote.text: tl;dr: it's getting better. We're living longer, homicides are down, fewer wars and autocracies, etc..
